<!-- pr-reviewer: 76ad31ba81b54cedc4655d995a046abb7090a653 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** This PR duplicates work that is already on `main`. Its only net change against `main` removes a named refusal, and a test fails.

## What I found

- Issue #3810 is closed. PR #3823 (`fix(2d): start-side Arc entry plunges in air outside the stock box`) fixed it and merged at 2026-11-24T06:19Z. Its commit `4289d2e53 fix(2d): air entry on the avoid route` does the avoid-route work that this PR describes.
- These files of this PR are byte-identical to `upstream/main` (`8bd377a82`): `air_entry.rs`, `air_entry_tests.rs`, `pocket_avoid.rs`, `pocket_avoid_level.rs`, `pocket.rs`, `pocket_emit.rs`, `descent*.rs`, `levels.rs`, `approach.rs`, `crates/app/tests/offset_pass_start.rs`, `docs/decisions/3746-air-entry.md`. The pin `avoid_route_entry_plunges_in_air_clear_of_a_clamp` is already in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/air_entry_tests.rs:226` on `main`.
- The trial merge with `main` gives one changed file: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer.rs` (+1 -8). This change is a revert of `72fa57718 fix(motion): give collapsed open chamfer run its own refusal message`. That commit is in the PR's own base (`a6cd476fd`), so the PR branch removes it.

## Results merged with main (locally, macOS, main `8bd377a82`)

Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`): 17 steps, 1 failed.

- ok: motion build, motion lib, `chamfer_circular`, `climb_direction`, `deburr`
- **FAIL: motion `chamfer_open_refusals`**
- ok: app build, `catalog_groove_part_off`, `chamfer_open_edges`, `continuous_4axis_part`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `first_4axis_part`, `first_part_programs`, `first_router_part`, `tilt_basis_compat`

```
test an_open_chamfer_collapsing_to_one_point_refuses_by_name ... FAILED
panicked at crates/motion/tests/chamfer_open_refusals.rs:56:5:
nothing to machine: a centerline run needs at least two points
test result: FAILED. 2 passed; 1 failed
```

The same suite on the same tree with `chamfer.rs` from `upstream/main`: `3 passed; 0 failed`. Thus this PR causes the failure. It is not red on `main`.

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Extra suites run: none owed. The net diff touches no `testdata/` file and no importer code.

## Mutation check (safety tier: the diff is in toolpath code)

- The net change of the PR is itself a mutation of the named refusal in `chamfer_open_runs`. `chamfer_open_refusals` catches it: red with the PR, green with `main`.
- The air-entry changes are identical to `main`. Thus the PR adds no new toolpath behaviour, and I did not mutate them again. No goldens moved.

## Requested before merge

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer.rs:206` and `:228` - do not remove the refusal "a chamfer edge collapses to one point - re-pick the edge" and its guard comment. Without it, a user who picks a collapsed edge gets the generic message "nothing to machine: a centerline run needs at least two points". The test `an_open_chamfer_collapsing_to_one_point_refuses_by_name` fails. Fix: `git checkout upstream/main -- crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer.rs`.
2. After fix 1, the PR has no change against `main`. #3823 already fixed #3810, and the issue is closed. Thus the PR body (`Fixes #3810`) and the `Changelog:` line describe work that is already on `main`. The recommended action is to close this PR as a duplicate of #3823. If the author has a different change in mind, please put only that change on a new branch from the latest `main`, with its own issue.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The PR body shows control characters in place of backticks (for example `\^Gvoid_route_...` and `\AirRoom\`). Please check the body text if the PR stays open.
- The author is not a collaborator. The maintainer decides on the merge or the close by hand.
Closed [PR #3839](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3839) as duplicate per AGENTS.md procedures
